text:
Edit the FIRST attached finished sprite into ONE next consecutive run-start frame. Output exactly one full-body Sora on white in a square canvas, matching the first image's position/size and polished KH2 cel-shaded design. Sora MUST FACE SCREEN-RIGHT: nose, gaze and boot toes point RIGHT in the same three-quarter camera. Preserve his face, hair shape, outfit colors, jacket/shorts folds, yellow-black boots, and body proportions. The second attached clean diagram is only the NEXT pose/weapon-axis guide. Render complete finished art, no diagram marks, text, grid, ground or layers.




This is frame04 immediately after the first reference's frame03. Keep the low bent-knee anticipation stance and planted feet. Move the FAR holding hand only a small distance upward to the guide's red marker at224,252 on a512px reference canvas (previous224-ish,270). Bend that far elbow naturally. Turn the entire connected Kingdom Key from slightly up-left to NEARLY VERTICAL at the back/left side, as the guide shows. The new guard remains near the back/left waist, NOT already beside the face or over the shoulder. The near hand has just released: it remains low and close to the guard at the green marker258,268, with a bent elbow, not fully swung forward. Exactly two arms/hands.




Keep ONE intact Kingdom Key of the SAME physical length and guard proportions as the first sprite. Black grip under the holding fingers, gold guard around it, blue collar continuing into one straight silver shaft, correct consistent crown teeth, chain attached at pommel. Handle/collar/shaft remain collinear. Retain the finished weapon form; the diagram's plain rod is only an axis cue. Draw a small real anatomical change into this next pose, not a scaled copy. No running stride, camera change, mirrored character or final shoulder carry yet. Return ONE finished image directly.
